message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are tallied from the cards left in opponents’ hands when you finish a round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the value of the top discard. If you have a Wild card, you can play it on any card and must declare the new color. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Uno Call** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in each opponent’s hand:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points.
Winner gets those points. | | **Game End** | Play continues until a player reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the color** – If you’re about to run out of cards, try to keep a card of the current color in reserve. 2. **Use Wild Draw Four wisely** – It’s powerful but risky; you can be challenged if you have a playable card. 3. **Watch the “UNO” rule** – Forgetting to call it can cost you two cards, so keep an eye on your hand size. 4. **Play defensively** – If you’re close to winning, consider playing a “Skip” or “Reverse” to block opponents from taking a turn. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
